content:
Twenty years of waiting ended Thursday night at Shirley Field.

The Cigarroa Toros beat Roma 29-28 on Nov. 5, clinching the program's first playoff berth since 2006, according to the Laredo Morning Times. The one-point district win sealed a postseason return two decades in the making for the south Laredo school.

Cigarroa entered the stretch run chasing history. As recently as late October, the Toros were still pushing toward their first playoff appearance since the 2006 season, and the win over Roma finally closed the deal.

The turnaround was built week by week. Cigarroa won three straight games in October, including a 14-7 win over Pharr-San Juan-Alamo Southwest on Oct. 22 that pushed the team to 5-3 on the season, according to MaxPreps.

What comes next

Playoff opponent and kickoff details had not been announced as of publication. For a program that has spent 20 years outside the postseason, Thursday night was the payoff — a one-point win, at home, with a playoff berth on the line.
